offset_signs: two-sided; censoring at the sensor floor makes the response asymmetric
risk_ranking_basis: median risk field over the 30 noise realisations

risk_metric.P_bar: expected fraction of the 48 h window below 0.2 mg/L (risk_* columns)
risk_metric.E_A: expected cumulative deficit in mg/L*h (deficit_* columns); this is the metric Step 10's headline top-10 is ranked by, and Step 8b showed the two can disagree about which nodes lead

summary.ess_criterion: median ESS < 100, the criterion of Section 2.5.1
summary.asymmetry_note: compare the +0.05 and -0.05 rows of the same node: the censoring count differs, so the two are not mirror images
